newsitem.title: USA: Michaels Stores Feb same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Michaels Stores Feb same-store sales up.

text.p: Michaels Stores Inc Wednesday said February sales rose eight percent to $97.9 million from $90.4 million in the prior year, while same-store sales for the month increased by five percent.

The company also said that options to purchase two million shares of Michaels' common stock were exercised on February 28 through private transactions with entities owned by independent trusts of which Wyly family members are beneficiaries. The shares are subject to various restrictions on future transfers. Sam Wyly is Michaels' chairman and Charles Wyly Jr. is Michaels' vice chairman.

As previously announced, the options were purchased by the trusts in December of 1996 with an exercise price equal to the then-current market price of $10.50 per share. The proceeds will be used to reduce 1997 seasonal borrowing requirements. Michaels is a retailer of arts, crafts, frames and floral products.
